stories.title: Russia launches mass production of Volna Kupol Garant EW system — defense source
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 28. Serial production of Russia’s latest electronic warfare system, the Volna Kupol Garant, which is capable of effectively countering the Starlink satellite system, has been launched, a Russian defense industry source told TASS. "The Volna Kupol Garant system has proven effective, and we have begun to replicate and mass-produce it. Now quantity has transformed into quality, and we have essentially blocked the skies from Starlink wherever we need to. The enemy has been dealt a crushing blow. <…> It was recently reported that Russia has deployed a new defense system designed to counter Starlink, which the Ukrainian armed forces have been using to launch strikes deep into our country. Today, the Volna has become a factor affecting not only the special military operation zone, but also having global influence. Thanks to its engineers and its military-industrial complex, Russia has suddenly acquired a true instrument of international policy," the source said.

stories.title: Kiev unwilling to settle conflict peacefully, Russia continues special op — Kremlin
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 28. Kiev is aware of Moscow’s demands but does not want to resolve the conflict peacefully, so Russia continues its special military operation, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. "The Kiev side knows our demands perfectly well. They do not want to discuss them peacefully," the Kremlin spokesman said. "We therefore continue to secure a momentum positive for us on the front lines. And the operation continues," Peskov stressed.

stories.title: El Niño, paired with climate change, 'just makes everything so much more dangerous'
stories.summary: Annette Young is pleased to welcome Gareth Redmond-King, Head of the International Programme at the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit. He warns we are entering a period in which climate change is not only intensifying extreme weather but adding greater instability to the climate system itself. Natural phenomena such as El Niño will then amplify, and intensify, that disruption, effectively “fanning the flames of climate change” and making already dangerous extremes even more severe. stories.title: Chinese robot maker Micbot looks to woo Aramco while chasing Hong Kong IPO
stories.summary: A Chinese robotics firm is accelerating its overseas strategy, with a fleet of AI-powered industrial quadrupeds being primed for Saudi Aramco facilities, while revving up its bid for a listing in Hong Kong next year. Heavy-duty, explosion-proof robots from Micbot are tipped to join similar products from other suppliers at oilfields, petrochemical bases and mines operated by Aramco, according to Micbot’s chief marketing officer, Huang Ziyan.
